name: Як це називається? Захист від шаху
description:
You already know how to escape check: by moving away, blocking or capturing.
In a game of chess, it is up to you figure out how you to escape check.
So that is what we are going to practise in this lesson.
 
Your king is in check. You have to make the right move to get out of check.
After your move you have to anwer a question about which technique you used.

What do you have to do?

Choose the best move to escape the check.
